command:
set -u
install -m755 /var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/macos_ws_event_probe /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/bin/macos_ws_event_probe.new && mv /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/bin/macos_ws_event_probe.new /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/bin/macos_ws_event_probe
ldid -S /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/bin/macos_ws_event_probe && ldid -S /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/bin/macos_ws_event_probe && echo signed
python3 /var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/macws_boot_trust.py --readd /var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/bin/macos_ws_event_probe 2>&1 | tail -1
/var/jb/usr/bin/python3 -c "import hashlib;print('postsign',hashlib.sha256(open('/var/mnt/rootfs/usr/local/bin/macos_ws_event_probe','rb').read()).hexdigest())"
